positioning.best_next_meeting: 30-minute technical fit call with named engineering owners and a workstream selection decision.
positioning.decision_question: Can EVTit help productize the evidence system so serious reviewers can inspect it faster?
positioning.one_sentence: A 30-day technical sprint to convert LumenCore's proof-to-pilot stack into a cleaner reviewer portal, repeatable evidence receipts, measured-source visibility, and pilot-ready intake gates.

workstreams.acceptance_check: A reviewer can identify thesis, source register, claim boundaries, and next validation gate in under five minutes.
workstreams.deliverable: A reviewer-facing portal surface with proof-card navigation, source register, and data-room links.
workstreams.evidence_output: public-safe screenshot, route map, hash-linked front-door artifact list
workstreams.problem: Reviewers need one clean path from thesis to artifacts without reading the whole repository.
workstreams.title: Proof portal front door

workstreams.acceptance_check: A dry-run receipt can be generated without external send, credentials, or capital movement.
workstreams.deliverable: A replay runner shell that records source, baseline, candidate, metric, run config, and SHA-256 receipt.
workstreams.evidence_output: run manifest JSON, markdown receipt, failure/negative-result slot
workstreams.problem: Evidence needs a repeatable path from source snapshot to baseline comparison to reviewer receipt.
workstreams.title: Replay runner and manifest

workstreams.acceptance_check: The UI visibly separates registry-measured rows from current hash-backed measured rows.
workstreams.deliverable: A concise UI/table for registry sources, current measured rows, hash status, and refresh gaps.
workstreams.evidence_output: source-register component, reconciliation note, no-claim banner
workstreams.problem: The source inventory must distinguish registry continuity from current hash-backed probe rows.
workstreams.title: Measured-source register UI

workstreams.acceptance_check: The flow blocks until human approves data boundary, economics, legal terms, and final share.
workstreams.deliverable: A gated onboarding flow: problem, data owner, baseline, metric, holdout window, scope, economics review.
workstreams.evidence_output: pilot intake checklist, authority stop points, acceptance-standard template
workstreams.problem: A serious partner needs to know exactly how a validation study would start without accepting terms on the call.
workstreams.title: Pilot onboarding path

workstreams.acceptance_check: Each job records success/failure status, cost boundary, and whether human action is required.
workstreams.deliverable: Retry, timeout, cost-limit, source-refresh, and status-receipt controls for proof-stack jobs.
workstreams.evidence_output: job receipt schema, status dashboard row, cost-control policy
workstreams.problem: Proof generation must be reliable enough for demos and bounded enough for budget review.
workstreams.title: API reliability and cost controls

workstreams.acceptance_check: A refresh produces manifest counts, gate status, E-drive receipt, and blocked-final-action flags.
workstreams.deliverable: A packet refresh workflow that rebuilds public-safe reviewer artifacts and machine controls.
workstreams.evidence_output: packet build log, data-room manifest, reviewer gate, E-drive hash receipt
